description: Use this when you need to add VAT to a net amount or take it out of a gross amount. Example prompt: "What is 21% BTW on 1,250 euros?" Add VAT to a net amount or extract VAT from a gross amount at any rate (e.g. 21 for Dutch BTW). Returns exact net, VAT, and gross amounts rounded to cents. Costs 1 credit. The answer is deterministic.

mode.description: add = amount is net, add VAT on top; extract = amount is gross, split out VAT

name: calculate_vat

result.description: The result, when it is not an object

title: VAT Calculator
